subject.title: cli-backend agent runs against anthropic (claude-cli runtime) return 401 authentication_failed while identical claude invocation works in shell

question: Should maintainers require a live macOS LaunchAgent Claude CLI OAuth reproduction before changing the managed Claude CLI auth/runtime path for this issue?
rationale: The reporter's trace matches current source, but the failing condition depends on live Claude CLI OAuth, launchd service context, loopback MCP, and local credential state that read-only source review cannot prove safely.

options.title: Require same-service proof
options.body: Run the gateway cron/channel path and a same-service Claude CLI replay with live and empty MCP configs before changing auth/runtime behavior.

options.title: Treat re-auth PRs as partial mitigation
options.body: Let the expired-token recovery-copy PRs proceed for their own issue, but keep this issue open until the gateway-only 401 is reproduced or disproven.

options.title: Patch from reporter trace
options.body: Sponsor a targeted backend/auth change from the wrapper trace now, accepting higher risk because the live trigger remains unproven.

recommendation.title: Require same-service proof
recommendation.body: Run the gateway cron/channel path and a same-service Claude CLI replay with live and empty MCP configs before changing auth/runtime behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Anthropic Claude CLI auth/runtime history makes this the strongest routing signal for the live proof and policy choice.
